evidence_gaps: No sanitized runtime forensics fresh within two hours; generated_epoch is zero.
No per-strategy, per-chain realized money-weighted NET P&L after every fee, slippage, impact, gas/priority charge and execution failure.
No explicit economic attribution separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No common-numeraire valuation, capital-at-risk exposure, drawdown, tail-loss or confidence-interval evidence.

proposals.downside_risk: Valuation joins and failure attribution can introduce bias unless prices, timestamps and attribution rules are immutable and auditable.

evidence.detail: Windows record net profit and execution-failure counts, but the schema lacks an explicit separation of STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss amounts.

proposals.expected_effect: Comparable capital-weighted NET P&L, drawdown and profit-factor evidence by strategy, chain and failure class.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 resolved attempts per chain, including at least 10 execution failures or an equivalent injected-failure suite, with 100% accounting reconciliation and explicit loss attribution.
proposals.rationale: Execution failures can consume gas or priority fees without being strategy losses. Outcome evidence should classify STRATEGY/MARKET loss separately from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure and retain both economic costs.
proposals.shadow_test: Record notional, capital-at-risk duration, chain, native and common-numeraire values, all costs, execution state and loss class for every attempted SHADOW trade. Reconcile gross proceeds minus fees, slippage, impact, gas/priority fees and failed-attempt costs to net P&L. Stop if reconciliation is non-zero beyond rounding tolerance or any failure is ambiguously classified.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote-only results may overstate fill quality, particularly during congestion, low liquidity and rapid token deterioration.

evidence.detail: Evidence status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch=0.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces falsifiable Solana net-edge and execution-quality evidence while retaining abstention.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 forward-SHADOW observations and 30 fully resolved eligible round trips across congestion and liquidity regimes.
proposals.rationale: Solana strategy economics cannot be evaluated without contemporaneous Jupiter-route quotes, sell simulation, priority/base fees, account/rent effects, impact, slippage and failure outcomes.
proposals.shadow_test: Capture entry and unwind quotes at decision time and configured horizons, including priority fees, base fees, refundable versus non-refundable rent, impact, slippage and failed-transaction costs. Compare modeled with executable or counterfactual realized NET P&L. Fail on missing sellability, stale quotes, negative net edge, or systematic model overstatement.

proposals.downside_risk: Historical simulation may miss mempool competition, MEV, nonce contention and state changes.

evidence.detail: Evidence status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS with generated_epoch=0.

proposals.expected_effect: Measures failure-adjusted EVM NET P&L and identifies whether losses are STRATEGY/MARKET selection losses or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 resolved eligible attempts on each evaluated EVM chain across multiple gas and volatility regimes.
proposals.rationale: The EVM adapter is economically broader than Solana's, but estimates do not demonstrate mined execution outcomes or account for reverted, replaced, dropped and partially completed attempts.
proposals.shadow_test: Forward-shadow each eligible route using block-consistent quotes and simulations, then observe inclusion outcome and counterfactual unwind. Charge gas and builder costs for failures where applicable. Fail if failure-adjusted aggregate net is non-positive, reconciliation is incomplete, or tail loss exceeds the predeclared bound.
proposals.strategy: EVM route and directional strategy families

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on current architecture, win count, or quote-simulation scorecards.
rejected_ideas.reason: There is no fresh runtime evidence, simulations are explicitly non-promotional, and raw win count does not establish durable money-weighted NET P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower edge, liquidity, sellability or simulation thresholds to increase activity.
rejected_ideas.reason: This would manufacture trades without proven executable edge and could worsen adverse selection and tail losses.

summary: No sanitised runtime forensics are available (generated_epoch=0). Evaluated codebase architecture logic for strategy_lab and cross_chain_strategy_signals. Identified that strategy_lab lacks explicit separation of STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure, preventing precise attribution of net P&L. Architecture has sound abstention controls, but profitability cannot be claimed without fresh runtime evidence.
